title: Several for loops accumulate with .push() instead of .map().collect()
description: email.rs:52-61, 66-72, 262-271, 273-278; mailbox.rs:39-43, 46-53; thread.rs:38-41; snippet.rs:72-75; submission.rs:53-67 — patterns like: let mut v = Vec::new(); for x in iter { v.push(serde_json::to_value(x).unwrap_or(Value::Null)); } should be written as: let v: Vec<Value> = iter.map(|x| serde_json::to_value(x).unwrap_or(Value::Null)).collect(); The iterator form is more idiomatic, does not require mut, and signals that the collection is a pure transformation.
